full_en: The Company is a technology company with two principal lines of business: (i) Tokenized Asset Finance, focused on digital asset and real-world asset tokenization via our Streamex Exchange platform, and (ii) Biomedical Technology, focused on advanced signal processing solutions in electrophysiology. In 2025, we expanded beyond our historical biomedical business through the strategic acquisition of Streamex Exchange, a developer of blockchain-based financial technology. This acquisition (completed in May 2025) marked our entry into financial Our Streamex Exchange platform (developed by Streamex Exchange prior to its acquisition) is designed as an institutional-grade system that enables the issuance, trading, and custody of digital tokens backed by tangible assets. The initial application of this platform is in the tokenized gold market: we have launched a tokenized gold product called GLDY, which provides investors with a digital token representing fractional interests in a special purpose vehicle domiciled in the Cayman Islands (the “SPV”), which holds physical gold and participates in a gold leasing program. Each GLDY Token corresponds to one troy ounce of gold held by the SPV, with yield features generated through gold leasing activities administered through a Tokenized Yield Partnership Agreement (the “MM Agreement”), by and between the Company and Monetary Metals & Co., a Delaware corporation (“Monetary Metals”).
